## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) with top gains concentrated in large-cap software; mixed internals and multiple large-cap 1W/1M divergences keep the regime neutral.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND. Communication/Media: GOOGL (1W: +0.51% | 1M: +3.88%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +7.23%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing pockets of strength: CME (1W: +3.93% | 1M: +6.95%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary weak: TSLA (1W: -3.89% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION, RCL (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -13.21%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare under pressure: LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY. Real Estate / Industrials lag: BA (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -3.34% | 1M: -1.10%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +17.22%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +17.60%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -6.34% | 1M: -1.48%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -13.21%) BELOW TREND, ROST (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -9.51%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated across payments, select tech and consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +17.22%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +17.60%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present — multiple large caps showing opposite 1W/1M signs; treat momentum as tactical, not universal.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but leadership concentrated: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +17.60%) ABOVE TREND versus AMAT (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND; sector is one of the four 1W positives so technology shows selective strength.

8. Financials Outlook?
Modestly constructive with dispersion: CME (1W: +3.93% | 1M: +6.95%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND while PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND highlights idiosyncratic pain points; financials provide tactical opportunities amid mixed internals.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive names mixed with cracks: JNJ (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +5.29%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION — sector is lagging on the week and shows rotational selling into names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Neutral regime — favor selectively positioned Financials and high-conviction above-trend Tech (e.g., CRM, MSFT) and monitor energy names like SLB; reduce exposure to PYPL, AMAT and weak consumer cyclicals (RCL/ROST). Style: Growth/Momentum bias but breadth is weak, so keep sizing cautious.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +17.22%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -13.21%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (one of 4 positive sectors) and Financials (pockets of strength). BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary and Healthcare given recent 1W weakness and negative internals.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +11.54%) ABOVE TREND — watch hold of recent breakout for continuation; AAPL (1W: +3.35% | 1M: -4.04%) RECOVERY — monitor whether 1W bounce sustains or fails; PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND — watch further weekly follow-through for trend confirmation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (+85): BA (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND — large bullish defense order headline but price remains below trend, a divergence to monitor. AMAT (+60): AMAT (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND — positive AI buildout narrative not yet confirmed in price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PYPL (-60): PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND — bearish news confirmed by strong price weakness. RCL (-40): RCL (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -13.21%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines align with the downtrend. META (-40): META (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +7.23%) ABOVE TREND — negative news but price is rising, a clear divergence.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum bias given concentrated Tech leadership but weak breadth. CRM (ABOVE TREND), MSFT (ABOVE TREND) and SLB (ABOVE TREND) are showing relative strength. Key risk is broad 1W/1M divergence across large caps (AAPL RECOVERY; XOM CORRECTION; TSLA CORRECTION) and headline-driven pressure on PYPL (-60) that could widen market internals.
